title: A rat model for retinitis pigmentosa with rapid retinal degeneration enables drug evaluation in vivo
author: Inoue, Takeuchi, et al.
materials: Copy number analysis was carried out using the TaqMan® Copy number assay. Genomic DNA was isolated with the High Pure PCR Template Preparation Kit (Roche, Mannheim, Germany). The TaqMan® Copy number assay was performed using LightCycler TaqMan® Master (Roche, Mannheim, Germany) and the primer sets listed in Supplemental Table 1. Reactions were performed and analyzed on a LightCycler DX400 (Roche, Mannheim, Germany).

steps.title: Select rhodopsin BAC clone
steps.instruction: Obtain rat rhodopsin BAC clone CH230‑100G19 from the BACPAC Resources Center (Children’s Hospital Oakland Research Institute) after confirming it contains the full rhodopsin genomic sequence plus ~100 kb flanking each end.

steps.title: Introduce P347L mutation
steps.instruction: Use the Red/ET Counter Selection BAC Modification Kit (Gene Bridges, Heidelberg, Germany) to amplify an rpsL‑neo counter‑selection cassette with 40‑nt left and right homology arms adjacent to the C‑to‑T site in exon 5, insert the cassette into the BAC by Red/ET recombination, then replace it with a modified exon 5 fragment (carrying the C‑to‑T change, KpnI, PstI, BglII sites) cloned into pGEM‑T Easy for sequencing.

steps.title: Verify BAC modification
steps.instruction: Confirm successful BAC recombineering by Southern blot analysis and DNA sequencing of the modified region.

steps.title: Purify BAC DNA
steps.instruction: Grow the modified BAC in 250 ml of E. coli culture and extract the plasmid using the Nucleobond Plasmid Purification kit (MACHEREY‑NAGEL, Düren, Germany).

steps.title: Linearize BAC DNA
steps.instruction: Take 10 µg of purified BAC DNA and incubate overnight with PI‑SceI endonuclease (New England Biolabs, Massachusetts, USA) to cut the unique site in the BACe3.6 vector.

steps.title: Separate and recover linear DNA
steps.instruction: Run the linearized DNA on pulsed‑field gel electrophoresis (PFGE), then extract the band by electroelution.

steps.title: Dialyze and QC DNA
steps.instruction: Dialyze the electroeluted DNA against TE buffer containing 0.1 mM EDTA, then run an aliquot on PFGE again to confirm size and quality.

steps.title: Adjust concentration and store
steps.instruction: Adjust the BAC DNA concentration to 1 ng/µl, aliquot, and store at 4 °C until microinjection.

steps.title: Pronuclear microinjection
steps.instruction: Inject the 1 ng/µl BAC DNA solution into pronuclei of Wistar rat embryos as previously described to generate rhodopsin P347L rats.

steps.title: Perform TUNEL staining
steps.instruction: Using the TACS‑XL In Situ Apoptosis Detection Kit (Trevigen, Gaithersburg, MD, USA), deparaffinize and rehydrate 4 µm paraffin sections, treat sequentially with proteinase K and 3 % hydrogen peroxide/methanol to quench endogenous peroxidase, incubate 30 min at 37 °C with Anti‑BrdU antibodies, then develop with the DAB Peroxidase Substrate Kit (ImmPACT, Vector Laboratories, CA, USA).

steps.title: Isolate genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from rat tissue using the High Pure PCR Template Preparation Kit (Roche, Mannheim, Germany).

steps.title: Run TaqMan copy number assay
steps.instruction: Set up the TaqMan® Copy Number assay with LightCycler TaqMan® Master (Roche, Mannheim, Germany) and the primer sets from Supplemental Table 1, then run and analyze reactions on a LightCycler DX400 (Roche, Mannheim, Germany).

steps.title: Statistical analysis of data
steps.instruction: Analyze results using Prism 7 (GraphPad, La Jolla, CA, USA) applying t‑test, two‑way ANOVA with Sidak’s multiple‑comparison test, or one‑way ANOVA with Tukey’s test as appropriate; consider p < 0.05 statistically significant.
